title: Create: Henry
description: A create add-on with Create: Dreams n Desires features and more.
body:
A Create add-on that continues the **Create: Dreams & Desires** feature set with retextured and remodeled content, plus extra machines and new ways to process.

## Features

### Machines & Kinetics
- Golden Mixer
- Hydraulic Press
- Industrial Fan
- Furnace Engine & Powered Flywheel
- Kinetic Motor
- Industrial Brake
- Bore Block
- Multimeter
- Redstone Divider
- Inverse Box

### Logistics
- Smart Hopper
- Roll Table
- Fluid Hatch

### Fan Processing
- Sanding
- Freezing
- Seething
- Withering
- Dragon Breathing

### Pressing
- Hydraulic Compacting

### Materials & Drinks
- Rubber, Raw Rubber, and their blocks
- Sap
- Coal Piece
- Lapis Lazuli Shard
- Kinetic Mechanism
- Milkshakes: Chocolate, Vanilla, Strawberry, Glowberry, Pumpkin

Ponder scenes are included as in-game guides, and JEI shows the custom recipe categories when enabled.

![Screenshot of the features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c13d13f1bc8cd857d4e06cb53f91f0b890c71b0_0.webp)

## Supported Create Versions
- **Create 0.6.x**
- **Create 0.5.1**
